concepts.name: A / Clean Circle
concepts.direction: Place the exact bold italic white A from the reference inside one perfectly circular white outline ring. The A is large but separated from the ring by generous navy clearance all around. Ring thickness approximately one third of the A's stem thickness. Keep the A optically centered despite its rightward slant. Pure timeless typography enclosed in a circle.

concepts.name: A / Solid Disc
concepts.direction: Use a solid white circular disc with the reference's exact heavy italic A cut out of its center in deep navy. The A stays completely enclosed by the disc, occupying roughly 62 percent of its diameter in height, with a clearly visible triangular counter. The letter is the only negative-space element. Crisp, simple badge with optical spacing.

concepts.name: A / Connected Ring
concepts.direction: Place the reference's extra-bold italic A in white within a broad white circular outline ring. Gently join just the A's lower left foot and lower right foot into the bottom ring, while leaving a generous navy gap between the A's top and the circle's upper arc. Keep the typography recognizably the exact squat right-leaning A from the reference, never an upright pointed architectural A. A robust unified circular lettermark with one dominant letter.

concepts.name: A / Classic Globe
concepts.direction: Center the reference's exact white extra-bold italic A over a minimal white wireframe globe: circular outline, one vertical elliptical meridian and one horizontal equator only. Globe lines much thinner than the heavy A. Mask any globe lines directly behind and closely adjacent to the letter with a broad invisible navy knockout so no line cuts across the A or confuses its counter. Keep globe lines visible only around the perimeter. Clearly an A inside a globe, beautifully spare.

concepts.name: A / Tilted Globe
concepts.direction: Put the exact white heavy italic A from the wordmark at the center of a compact circular globe whose single meridian and equator are tilted about 25 degrees in the same forward direction as the A. Thin confident white globe arcs visible only in the outer perimeter, with navy knockout clearance around the solid white letter. One outer circle plus two curved internal globe bands maximum. The contrast between bold letter and spare tilted globe conveys connected global progress.

concepts.name: A / Orbit Globe
concepts.direction: A large exact white extra-bold italic A from the reference inside a clean circular white globe outline. A single elliptical orbit sweeps around the globe from lower left to upper right, extending only slightly beyond the circle. Keep the orbit broad and simple, clearly behind the letter with clean negative-space clearance; no line crosses the A. No additional latitude lines or orbiting dots. Energetic but restrained, strong right-leaning typographic center and distinctive circular orbital silhouette.
